scripts.dev: bun scripts/adecore.ts status --brief && bun run --filter './apps/*' dev
scripts.dev:built: bun scripts/adecore.ts status --brief && bun run --cwd apps/client build && bun run --parallel dev:client:built dev:server dev:desktop:built
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/client build && bun run --cwd apps/desktop build
scripts.check: bun run check:types && bun run check:generated && bun run lint && bun run format:check
scripts.check:types: bun check --no-script -p tsconfig.scripts.json && bun run --filter '*' typecheck
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings && oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings -c apps/server/oxlint.promises.json apps/server/src && bun scripts/check-client-conventions.ts && bun scripts/check-test-clock.ts
scripts.test:browser: bun run --cwd apps/client build && bun scripts/test-integration.ts --browser
scripts.dist: bun run --cwd apps/client build && bun run --cwd apps/server compile && bun run --cwd apps/desktop pack
